trickyParts: Findings 4 and 5 are one decision and it was mine to take. I chose the `?thread=1` the Conversation sets plus a caller-side answers merge, over the reviewer's sharper alternative of serving `edits`/`answers`/`followers` and letting the card take `replies` from the comments list. The sharper one would have the ask card's initial data arrive from two independently invalidating queries, so a reply could render against an ask row from before it - a correctness surface bought for a payload saving the parameter already gets.

Because the Conversation now asks a different question of the same route, its query key could no longer be the margin's `["asks", key]`. It is `["asks", key, "thread"]`, deliberately under that prefix: `refreshQueries` invalidates with no `exact`, `coalescePrefixKeys` never narrows a queued key, and both direct callers pass `["asks", <issueKey>]`, so every existing invalidation reaches it by prefix and no new one was added. The cost is one extra request on an issue page, which `e2e/live.e2e.ts`'s exact budget now names.

The pin-write lift removed the third copy of a sequence the repository had twice. `features/margin/useMarginSheet.ts` keeps its own on purpose: the review margin's behaviour must not move in this change, and the reviewer's own finding said a local banner would have been acceptable.

The reviewer's literal dependency list for the focus-latch fix fails biome's `useExhaustiveDependencies`, which rejects a dependency the body never reads. `shown` became a real read (the effect returns early when the named card is not on the page) and `openThreads` was dropped, since it cannot change without changing `shown`'s identity - it is one of `shown`'s `useMemo` inputs and the memo returns a fresh array.
deviations: The `ViewportAnchor` the reviewer prescribed carries `label="Activity"`, not `label="Issue activity"`. A section with the list's own label would have shadowed it for `e2e/attention.e2e.ts:141`, which passes `[aria-label="Issue activity"]` to `readingAnchor` and takes the first match. It mirrors the Conversation, whose anchor is `label="Conversation"` beside its `aria-label="Conversation turns"` list.

The first run of `envoy-go` on the pre-merge fix head failed on `TestCreateAskOnIssueKeepsSuggestionsWhenWriteAdviceFails` (`suggestions_test.go:384`), which nothing in this change touches: the test asserts `write_suggestions` rows exist the moment the ask response returns, while `persistSuggestions` writes them under a deadline derived for the search and decision lookup and only logs a row it cannot insert, so a loaded runner can drop it. I re-ran the failed job rather than pushing, per the rule, and it passed. The architect filed it as dispatch://INFRA-56; nothing was changed for it here.

The body's other flagged claim - that the Playwright and Go suites cannot run in a Legion worker pod - was already corrected at 12:10Z, before the review was written; the reviewer's note was against an earlier reading.
